capabilities: Convert handwritten or whiteboard images into .canvas files
Map handwritten sections to nodes with absolute coordinates and dimensions
Detect arrows and group boxes and translate them into canvas edges and groups
Convert clipboard screenshots via a command
Convert vault image files from the file explorer context menu
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes a standalone test script and a Chinese documentation link.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas only builds whiteboards manually, so handwritten notes captured as images stay locked in picture form rather than becoming editable nodes and edges.

relations.evidence: Seamlessly connects to Google AI Studio (Gemini), OpenAI API, or local MLLM gateways.
OpenAI & Google AI Studio Compatible API Seamlessly connects to Google AI Studio (Gemini), OpenAI API

requires.name: Vision model API key (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, or local gateway)

summary: Converts photos of handwritten notes, whiteboard sketches and mind maps into structured .canvas whiteboards using vision AI models.
